verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיָּ֕מָת נָחָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·yā·māṯ nā·ḥāš me·leḵ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn way·yim·lōḵ bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Some time later . . . Nahash king of the Ammonites . . . died and was succeeded by . . . his son
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU, depois disto que Naás, rei dos filhos de Amom, morreu; e seu filho reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ חֶ֣סֶד׀ עִם־ חָנ֣וּן בֶּן־ נָחָ֗שׁ כִּֽי־ עָשָׂ֨ה אָבִ֤יו עִמִּי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד מַלְאָכִ֖ים לְנַחֲמ֣וֹ עַל־ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּבֹאוּ֩ עַבְדֵ֨י דָוִ֜יד אֶל־ אֶ֧רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֛וֹן אֶל־ חָנ֖וּן לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- ḥe·seḏ ‘im- ḥā·nūn ben- nā·ḥāš kî- ‘ā·śāh ’ā·ḇîw ‘im·mî ḥe·seḏ way·yiš·laḥ dā·wîḏ mal·’ā·ḵîm lə·na·ḥă·mōw ‘al- ’ā·ḇîw way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wîḏ ’el- ’e·reṣ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ’el- ḥā·nūn lə·na·ḥă·mōw
verses.literal: And David said I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash because his father showed kindness to me So David sent messengers to console Hanun concerning his father But when David’s servants arrived in the land of the Ammonites . . . . . . . . . to console him
verses.literalPt: Então disse Davi: Usarei de benevolência com Hanum, filho de Naás, porque seu pai usou de benevolência comigo. Por isso Davi enviou mensageiros para o consolarem acerca de seu pai. E, chegando os servos de Davi à terra dos filhos de Amom, a Hanum, para o consolarem,

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י בְנֵי־ עַמּ֜וֹן לְחָנ֗וּן הַֽמְכַבֵּ֨ד דָּוִ֤יד אֶת־ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־ שָׁלַ֥ח לְךָ֖ מְנַחֲמִ֑ים הֲלֹ֡א בַּ֠עֲבוּר לַחְקֹ֨ר וְלַהֲפֹ֤ךְ וּלְרַגֵּל֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ בָּ֥אוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֵלֶֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū śā·rê ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn lə·ḥā·nūn ham·ḵab·bêḏ dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā kî- šā·laḥ lə·ḵā mə·na·ḥă·mîm hă·lō ba·‘ă·ḇūr laḥ·qōr wə·la·hă·p̄ōḵ ū·lə·rag·gêl hā·’ā·reṣ bā·’ū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: the princes of the Ammonites . . . said to Hanun Just because David has sent you comforters do you really believe he is showing respect for your father Have not his servants come to you to explore the land spy it out and overthrow it
verses.literalPt: Disseram os príncipes dos filhos de Amom a Hanum: Pensas porventura, que foi para honrar teu pai aos teus olhos, que Davi te mandou consoladores? Não vieram seus servos a ti, a esquadrinhar, e a transtornar, e a espiar a terra?

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חָנ֜וּן אֶת־ עַבְדֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ וַֽיְגַלְּחֵ֔ם וַיִּכְרֹ֧ת אֶת־ מַדְוֵיהֶ֛ם בַּחֵ֖צִי עַד־ הַמִּפְשָׂעָ֑ה וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ḥā·nūn ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wîḏ way·ḡal·lə·ḥêm way·yiḵ·rōṯ ’eṯ- maḏ·wê·hem ba·ḥê·ṣî ‘aḏ- ham·mip̄·śā·‘āh way·šal·lə·ḥêm
verses.literal: So Hanun took David’s servants shaved their beards cut off their garments at the hips and sent them away
verses.literalPt: Por isso Hanum tomou os servos de Davi, e raspou-os, e cortou-lhes as vestes no meio até à coxa da perna, e os despediu.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ וַיַּגִּ֨ידוּ לְדָוִ֤יד עַל־ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח לִקְרָאתָ֔ם כִּי־ הָי֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים נִכְלָמִ֣ים מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ שְׁב֣וּ בִֽירֵח֔וֹ עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ יְצַמַּ֥ח זְקַנְכֶ֖ם וְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū way·yag·gî·ḏū lə·ḏā·wîḏ ‘al- hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yiš·laḥ liq·rā·ṯām kî- hā·yū hā·’ă·nā·šîm niḵ·lā·mîm mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ šə·ḇū ḇî·rê·ḥōw ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- yə·ṣam·maḥ zə·qan·ḵem wə·šaḇ·tem
verses.literal: When someone came and told David about his men he sent messengers to meet them since the men had been thoroughly humiliated The king told them Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back and then return
verses.literalPt: E foram-se, e avisaram a Davi acerca daqueles homens; e enviou ele mensageiros a encontrá-los; porque aqueles homens estavam sobremaneira envergonhados. Disse, pois, o rei: Deixai-vos ficar em Jericó, até que vos torne a crescer a barba, e então voltai.

verses.original: וַיִּרְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן כִּ֥י הִֽתְבָּאֲשׁ֖וּ עִם־ דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חָ֠נוּן וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן אֶ֣לֶף כִּכַּר־ כֶּ֗סֶף לִשְׂכֹּ֣ר לָ֠הֶם מִן־ אֲרַ֨ם נַהֲרַ֜יִם וּמִן־ אֲרַ֤ם מַעֲכָה֙ וּמִצּוֹבָ֔ה רֶ֖כֶב וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn kî hiṯ·bā·’ă·šū ‘im- dā·wîḏ way·yiš·laḥ ḥā·nūn ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ’e·lep̄ kik·kar- ke·sep̄ liś·kōr lā·hem min- ’ă·ram na·hă·ra·yim ū·min- ’ă·ram ma·‘ă·ḵāh ū·miṣ·ṣō·w·ḇāh re·ḵeḇ ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm
verses.literal: When the Ammonites . . . . . . realized that they had become a stench to David Hanun and the Ammonites . . . sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim . . . . . . Aram-maacah and Zobah
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, os filhos de Amom que se tinham feito odiosos para com Davi, enviou Hanum, e os filhos de Amom, mil talentos de prata para alugarem para si carros e cavaleiros da Mesopotâmia, e da Síria de Maaca, e de Zobá.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂכְּר֣וּ לָהֶ֡ם שְׁנַיִם֩ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְאֶת־ מֶ֤לֶךְ מַעֲכָה֙ וְאֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י מֵידְבָ֑א וּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֗וֹן נֶאֶסְפוּ֙ מֵעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·kə·rū lā·hem šə·na·yim ū·šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ re·ḵeḇ wə·’eṯ- me·leḵ ma·‘ă·ḵāh wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mōw way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·ya·ḥă·nū lip̄·nê mê·ḏə·ḇā ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ne·’es·p̄ū mê·‘ā·rê·hem way·yā·ḇō·’ū lam·mil·ḥå̄·må̄h
verses.literal: So they hired for themselves thirty-two . . . thousand chariots as well as the king of Maacah with his troops who came and camped near Medeba while the Ammonites . . . were mustered from their cities . . . and marched out for battle
verses.literalPt: E alugaram para si trinta e dois mil carros, e o rei de Maaca e o seu povo, e eles vieram, e se acamparam diante de Medeba; também os filhos de Amom se ajuntaram das suas cidades, e vieram para a guerra.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶת־ יוֹאָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ צָבָ֖א הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ dā·wîḏ way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- yō·w·’āḇ wə·’êṯ kāl- ṣā·ḇā hag·gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: On hearing this David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men
verses.literalPt: O que ouvindo Davi, enviou Joabe e todo o exército dos homens valentes.

verses.original: וַיֵּצְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיַּֽעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה פֶּ֣תַח הָעִ֑יר וְהַמְּלָכִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֔אוּ לְבַדָּ֖ם בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn way·ya·‘ar·ḵū mil·ḥā·māh pe·ṯaḥ hā·‘îr wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer- bā·’ū lə·ḇad·dām baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: The Ammonites . . . marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance to the city while the kings who had come stayed by themselves in the open country
verses.literalPt: E, saindo os filhos de Amom, ordenaram a batalha à porta da cidade; porém os reis que vieram se puseram à parte no campo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יוֹאָ֗ב כִּֽי־ הָיְתָ֧ה פְנֵי־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֑וֹר וַיִּבְחַ֗ר מִכָּל־ בָּחוּר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ לִקְרַ֥את אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yō·w·’āḇ kî- hā·yə·ṯāh p̄ə·nê- ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’ê·lāw pā·nîm wə·’ā·ḥō·wr way·yiḇ·ḥar mik·kāl bā·ḥūr bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·rōḵ liq·raṯ ’ă·rām
verses.literal: When Joab saw - the battle lines before him and behind him he selected some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Arameans
verses.literalPt: E, vendo Joabe que a batalha estava preparada contra ele, pela frente e pela retaguarda, separou dentre os mais escolhidos de Israel, e os ordenou contra os sírios.

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם נָתַ֕ן בְּיַ֖ד אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֑יו וַיַּ֣עַרְכ֔וּ לִקְרַ֖את בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ye·ṯer hā·‘ām nā·ṯan bə·yaḏ ’aḇ·šay ’ā·ḥîw way·ya·‘ar·ḵū liq·raṯ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: And he placed the rest of the troops under the command of his brother Abishai who arrayed them against the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: E o resto do povo entregou na mão de Abisai, seu irmão; e puseram-se em ordem de batalha contra os filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אִם־ תֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ אֲרָ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתָ לִּ֖י לִתְשׁוּעָ֑הס וְאִם־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֛וֹן יֶֽחֶזְק֥וּ מִמְּךָ֖ וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’im- te·ḥĕ·zaq mim·men·nî ’ă·rām wə·hā·yî·ṯā lî liṯ·šū·ʿå̄·hs wə·’im- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ye·ḥez·qū mim·mə·ḵā wə·hō·wō·ša‘·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: If the Arameans are too strong for me said Joab then you will come to my rescue And if the Ammonites . . . are too strong for you then I will come to your rescue
verses.literalPt: E disse: Se os sírios forem mais fortes do que eu, tu virás socorrer-me; e, se os filhos de Amom forem mais fortes do que tu, então eu te socorrerei.

verses.original: חֲזַ֤ק וְנִֽתְחַזְּקָה֙ בְּעַד־ עַמֵּ֔נוּ וּבְעַ֖ד עָרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽיהוָ֔ה הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינָ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zaq wə·niṯ·ḥaz·zə·qāh bə·‘aḏ- ‘am·mê·nū ū·ḇə·‘aḏ ‘ā·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū Yah·weh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nāw ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God May the LORD do what is good in His sight
verses.literalPt: Esforça-te, e esforcemo-nos pelo nosso povo, e pelas cidades do nosso Deus, e faça o SENHOR o que parecer bem aos seus olhos.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ יוֹאָ֜ב וְהָעָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּ֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיָּנ֖וּסוּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš yō·w·’āḇ wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- ‘im·mōw lip̄·nê ’ă·rām lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·yā·nū·sū mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: So Joab and his troops - advanced to fight the Arameans who fled before him
verses.literalPt: Então se chegou Joabe, e o povo que tinha consigo, diante dos sírios, para a batalha; e fugiram de diante dele.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֤וֹן רָאוּ֙ כִּי־ נָ֣ס אֲרָ֔ם וַיָּנ֣וּסוּ גַם־ הֵ֗ם מִפְּנֵי֙ אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ הָעִ֑ירָה וַיָּבֹ֥א יוֹאָ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn rā·’ū kî- nās ’ă·rām way·yā·nū·sū ḡam- hêm mip·pə·nê ’aḇ·šay ’ā·ḥîw way·yā·ḇō·’ū hā·‘î·rāh way·yā·ḇō yō·w·’āḇ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: When the Ammonites . . . saw that the Arameans had fled they too fled before Joab’s brother Abishai and they entered the city So Joab went back to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, os filhos de Amom que os sírios fugiram, também eles fugiram de diante de Abisai, seu irmão, e entraram na cidade; e veio Joabe para Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא אֲרָ֗ם כִּ֣י נִגְּפוּ֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־ אֲרָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר וְשׁוֹפַ֛ךְ שַׂר־ צְבָ֥א הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ă·rām kî nig·gə·p̄ū lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yiš·lə·ḥū mal·’ā·ḵîm way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·rām ’ă·šer mê·‘ê·ḇer han·nā·hār wə·šō·w·p̄aḵ śar- ṣə·ḇā hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel they sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them
verses.literalPt: E, vendo os sírios que foram derrotados diante de Israel, enviaram mensageiros, e fizeram sair os sírios que habitavam do outro lado do rio; e Sofaque, capitão do exército de Hadar-Ezer, marchava diante deles.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֣ד לְדָוִ֗יד וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲרֹ֨ךְ דָּוִ֜יד לִקְרַ֤את אֲרָם֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·ḏā·wîḏ way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr hay·yar·dên way·yā·ḇō ’ă·lê·hem way·ya·‘ă·rōḵ ’ă·lê·hem way·ya·‘ă·rōḵ dā·wîḏ liq·raṯ ’ă·rām mil·ḥā·māh way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: When this was reported to David he gathered all Israel crossed the Jordan advanced toward the Arameans and arrayed for battle against them When David lined up to engage them in battle they fought against him
verses.literalPt: Do que avisado Davi, ajuntou a todo o Israel, e passou o Jordão, e foi ter com eles, e ordenou contra eles a batalha; e, tendo Davi ordenado a batalha contra os sírios, pelejaram contra ele.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣נָס אֲרָם֮ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג דָּוִ֜יד מֵאֲרָ֗ם שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ רֶ֔כֶב וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וְאֵ֛ת שׁוֹפַ֥ךְ שַֽׂר־ הַצָּבָ֖א הֵמִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·nās ’ă·rām mil·lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·hă·rōḡ dā·wîḏ mê·’ă·rām šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm re·ḵeḇ wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ ’îš raḡ·lî wə·’êṯ šō·w·p̄aḵ śar- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā hê·mîṯ
verses.literal: But the Arameans fled before Israel and David . . . killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers . . . He also killed Shophach the commander of their army
verses.literalPt: Porém os sírios fugiram de diante de Israel, e feriu Davi, dos sírios, os homens de sete mil carros, e quarenta mil homens de pé; e a Sofaque, capitão do exército, matou.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֞וּ עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֗זֶר כִּ֤י נִגְּפוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּשְׁלִ֥ימוּ עִם־ דָּוִ֖יד וַיַּֽעַבְדֻ֑הוּ וְלֹא־ אָבָ֣ה אֲרָ֔ם לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֖וֹן עֽוֹד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ‘aḇ·ḏê hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer kî nig·gə·p̄ū lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yaš·lî·mū ‘im- dā·wîḏ way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·hū wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh ’ă·rām lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: When Hadadezer’s subjects saw that they had been defeated by Israel they made peace with David and became subject to him So the Arameans were unwilling . . . to help the Ammonites . . . anymore
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, os servos de Hadar-Ezer que tinham sido feridos diante de Israel, fizeram paz com Davi, e o serviram; e os sírios nunca mais quiseram socorrer os filhos de Amom.
